disclosure: Frozen after seeing substantial document-level overlap in completed independent diagnostic; exploratory plan, not a predeclared confirmatory sample.
scope: DocVQA third-party train metadata only, no labels or predictions, no training, no change to original image split.
graph: Bipartite nodes are exact nonempty source document IDs and accepted image group IDs; edge for each source row. Close transitively across all source rows before exclusion.
exclude: Every component with any member group previously excluded_eval, or any member document occurring in all frozen DocVQA evaluation manifest rows, is excluded as a whole.
component_id: sha256 UTF-8 canonical compact JSON object with sorted docs and sorted group IDs (sort_keys true, ensure_ascii true).
assignment: Sort nonexcluded components by SHA256(20261105|TRAIN_DOC_COMPONENT|component_id), tie by component_id; first floor(4*n/5) fit, rest validation; atomic per component.
checks: Complete accounting; unique question IDs; no document or image group in multiple splits; no eligible component connected to evaluation group or evaluation document; report component sizes, rows/groups/documents and imbalance.
limitations: Exact IDs identify shared documents, not semantic document variants.
Images or documents may still evade perceptual and source identity matching.
Third-party source equivalence to official release remains unverified.
Post-hoc exploratory split is not authorization to train.
